title: BackGuiner: Yomigaeru Yuushatachi: Hishou-hen: Uragiri no Senjou
native_title: バックガイナー ～よみがえる勇者たち～ 飛翔編「うらぎりの戦場」
overview:
Even if only a 1% chance remains, we will not give up, and we will never despair.

The Soaring chapter, subtitled Battlefield of Betrayal, picks up the BackGuiner story directly where the Awakening chapter left off. The special mobile unit and its pilots return to defend Earth, while two of the squad's girls squabble over which of them is really the heroine. As before, the drama plays out in animated story scenes and conversations, and the fighting takes place in turn-based tactical battles where each unit has limited movement per turn and a choice of attack types.

- Second chapter of the BackGuiner story
- Animated event and battle scenes
- Single player
- Memory backup save
- Two discs

たとえ1％でも可能性が残っているのなら私たちは諦めない、決して絶望しない。
